breakdown.description: The prompt treats the original x–y axes as principal directions even though a nonzero shear stress is present, so the principal stresses are not simply σ_x and 0.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly omits the erroneous claim that principal directions remain aligned with the original x-y axes when shear stress is present. Instead, it instructs using standard stress transformation equations to compute the principal stresses σ_1 and σ_2, which matches the ground truth approach of properly computing principal stresses from the full plane stress state (σx, σy=0, τxy).
